purpose: Task 77I Stage 1 -- authoritative position/open-order reconciliation, freshness/unknown-state handling, atomic reservations, idempotent retries, and timed-out-submission handling. Disclosed, not overclaimed.

existing_locking_architecture.conclusion: No cross-process advisory locking exists anywhere in this codebase today. This task does not add one -- see implementation_plan.md's 'Concurrency -- disclosed, not invented' section for why, and what already holds instead.

within_process_atomicity.conclusion: Two 'competing' order_intent calls originating in the same live-session process (the only process that ever calls order_intent -- see execution_path_inventory.md) cannot interleave; the second call always observes the first's effect.

cross_process_writers.conclusion: The one per-order-mutating code path (order_intent) has no real multi-process writer in the current architecture; bulk-flatten paths reachable from a second process were already exempt from per-order validation before this task and remain so.

timed_out_submission_handling.before: poll_order_until_terminal returned silently on timeout; nothing marked the order's true outcome as unknown; nothing prevented treating it as inert.
timed_out_submission_handling.after: order.status set to sentinel 'UNCONFIRMED_TIMEOUT' (outside _TERMINAL_ORDER_STATUSES, so oversell/pyramiding/pending-entry guards continue to treat it as outstanding); a BROKER_ERROR event is emitted; reconcile() actively resolves it via a fresh broker.get_order() read on every call.
timed_out_submission_handling.never_blindly_resubmitted: the duplicate-intent-id guard (stable_id from signal_id+symbol+side+quantity) already prevents resubmitting the SAME signal_id, and PENDING_ENTRY_EXISTS/OVERSIZED_OR_DUPLICATE_SELL block a DIFFERENT signal_id for the same symbol while the order remains unresolved.

restart_recovery.mechanism: LifecycleState is a full-file JSON rewrite, re-loaded in PaperLifecycle.__init__ -- a freshly-constructed instance pointed at the same state_path sees exactly the same intents/orders/positions/open_position_by_symbol/reconciliation_flags as before the restart.

shadow_holding_never_authorises_a_broker.structural_proof: ShadowLedger has zero import of, or reference to, PaperLifecycle/AlpacaPaperClient/order_intent anywhere in shadow_ledger.py -- confirmed by grep. It cannot call order_intent even if it wanted to; the two systems are connected only by a shared, read-only decision_id.
